findings.source_behavior: A rotation R_v^B may alternatively be presented by the rotor U=exp(B/2), with exact role-distinct actions v'=U v U^{-1} and Psi'=U Psi; the source additionally writes first-order approximations (not exact equalities).

findings.source_behavior: B=(1/2)B^{cd}gamma_cd is a Clifford bivector with separate chiral blocks B_m and B_p.
findings.missing_in: L-SSC-131 and source-complete L131 replay; L132 G1 R14 contains an infinitesimal chiral generator claim but cannot substitute for L131 finite rotor action.

findings.source_behavior: Generalized m- and p-role rotations are explicitly written as t-conjugates of the v-role rotor: R_m^B=t^2 R_v^B t and R_p^B=t R_v^B t^2.
